facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note owes the party about 975 gold for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price), payable only once the caravans flow again.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note each hireling gets or when they are to be paid.

facts.text: The party must let Cedric have the barrow treasure covered by his promissory note so he can truck it to town once the caravans flow again.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say whether the treasure was handed over to Cedric when the note was signed or is still held by the party.
